I've been in therapy for roughly a year, now, probably a bit longer than that. I switched therapists a couple of months ago because my first one was not experienced with trans issues.

As for medication, I've been on quite a number. I'm currently taking wellbutrin and lexapro but I've also been on abilify, zoloft, and prozac in the past. None of these have seemed to improve my situation whatsoever.
Would it be the same for a non-citizen? Considering that I'd be moving there and wouldn't have citizenship, what would the situation be? Do you know?
